# Awesome Open

> A curated directory of software whose names begin with “Open”, across open-source and proprietary projects.

## Directory guide

- [Awesome Open summary and source index](https://github.com/awesomeopen/awesome-open/blob/main/llm.txt): Scope, category navigation, metric interpretation, contribution rules, and licensing sources. The maintained overview lives in llm.txt; this llms.txt file provides the conventional discovery entry point.
